faq.question: Is this a complete game map?
faq.answer: No. These are invented demonstration regions and pins. The real total is unknown.

faq.question: Where is my progress saved?
faq.answer: In this browser under this site's map and data version. No progress is uploaded.

faq.question: Can I use the map with a keyboard or phone?
faq.answer: Use the zoom buttons and written list to access all supplied pin information.
